The friendly schedule below helps to get an overview of your friendlies. Book a friendly either by challenge a friend, or type in a user/club name into the search column. Match days available for both teams will show up in the schedule below. Choose desired day, send a challenge and then wait for the opponent to accept it.

You should play friendlies every week to receive important revenue for the club, but also to gain valuable experience and maintain the form of your players. ?
